title: docs(releases): 18.6.0 is on npm with 64 breaking changes but has no release page (`releases/v18/18-6.mdx`) and no v18.6.0 row in `upgrading.mdx`
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the post-release npm smoke #35181, cell F1a.

## What happens
18.6.0 was published to npm on 2026-11-18 (release commit `958ee035`, "chore: version packages (#33849)"). Neither the release commit nor `origin/main` (`55020c331b` at the run, re-checked by the seat afterwards) has `content/docs/releases/v18/18-6.mdx`, or a v18.6.0 row in `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`. Meanwhile `releases/index.mdx` already says "current series: 18.6.0", and `v18/index.mdx` still calls 18.5.0 "the next release".

## Reproduction
1. `git show 958ee035:content/docs/upgrading.mdx | grep -n 'v18\.6'` → no row.
2. `git ls-tree --name-only 958ee035 content/docs/releases/v18/` → `18-0` … `18-5`, `index.mdx`, `meta.json`; no `18-6.mdx`.
3. The same on `origin/main`.

## Why it matters
- 64 `!:` commits lie in `b914e724..958ee035`. Their CHANGELOG lines are all present (#33903's fix holds), but no upgrade row or page reaches them.
- 18.6.0's `os migrate` guidance has no page. For example: the audit seal lock `--sealer-stopped`; the 45–50 safe `create_index` changes that `os migrate plan` lists on an upgrade; the cli's "new in this release" wording.
- For comparison, 18.5.0's page and row landed 48 minutes before its publish (#33823, card #33798).

## Expected
An `upgrading.mdx` row and an `18-6.mdx` page with an upgrade checklist. Also correct the release status and table in `v18/index.mdx`. Details for each item are in #35181's cells D and F and its observations O-D3, O-D4, O-D5 and O-F2.

QA-source: #35181 · smoke:npm-18.6.0 · F1a
